name: Ghostwalk
intel: Ghost Code: a cloaked unit. Only Rapid and Lightning can acquire it. Build at least one before this wave.

name: Stealth Screen
intel: Cloaked units screen a Healer. Lightning hits both simultaneously. Do not ignore the stealth units.

name: Hunter Stalk
intel: Hunters plus cloaked units. Guardian cannot detect Ghost Code — deploy only if Sniper is covering it.

name: Special Ground Mix
intel: Stealth, splitters, and runners simultaneously. Lightning handles cloaked and chain-hits the pack.

name: Broken Corridor Finale
intel: Every special ground type at once. Rapid detects cloaked, Lightning chains, Sniper eliminates Hunters.
